## Scientific computing, astronomy software, and reproducible data analysis

I am **Abdullah Korra**, a Math-Physics student at The College of Idaho with interests in **scientific computing**, **machine learning**, **astronomy data reduction**, and **robotics**. My work centers on building careful, usable tools in **Python**, **pandas**, **scikit-learn**, and version-controlled, reproducible workflows. I am especially interested in projects that connect computation, physical systems, and real-world problem solving.

::: {.tag-row}
[Scientific Python]{.tag}
[Machine Learning]{.tag}
[Astronomy Data Reduction]{.tag}
[Robotics]{.tag}
[Reproducible Analysis]{.tag}
:::

## What I do {.section-block}

::: {.info-grid}
::: {.info-card}
### Build reproducible analysis
I work in Python with clear project structure, careful data preparation, and readable outputs intended for both technical and non-technical readers.
:::

::: {.info-card}
### Connect computation to physical systems
My projects sit at the intersection of data, instrumentation, robotics, and scientific research.
:::

::: {.info-card}
### Communicate results cleanly
I prefer prose-forward reporting, clean figures, and practical conclusions over notebook dumps and walls of code.
:::
:::
